name: @ and www (existing records)
purpose: At least 48 hours before the cutover lower the TTL of the existing apex and www records to 300 seconds so the switch and a rollback propagate quickly. Nothing else changes in this step.

name: staging
value: <staging edge address: terraform output app_reserved_ips of the staging root>
purpose: staging.dungeonfluxdnd.com serves the staging environment's edge. Must exist and answer over HTTPS before the production cutover so the whole edge (docs site and /app/ and /sessions/*) is rehearsed on a real name.

name: mail
purpose: SPF for the transactional mail subdomain: only the chosen mail provider may send as mail.dungeonfluxdnd.com. The provider is an owner decision; use exactly the include its console gives.

name: <dkim selector>._domainkey.mail
value: <value the mail provider gives for each DKIM key>
purpose: DKIM keys for mail.dungeonfluxdnd.com. Usually one to three records; the provider names the selectors and says whether each is a CNAME or a TXT. Enter them exactly; GoDaddy wants TXT values without surrounding quotes.

name: _dmarc.mail
purpose: DMARC for the mail subdomain. Start at p=none to collect reports; the report mailbox is an owner decision (it may be on any domain that accepts the reports).

value: <production edge address: the load balancer address (terraform output) or in the pilot without one the application Droplet reserved address>
purpose: The apex. Replace the four GitHub Pages A records (expected 185.199.108.153 and 185.199.109.153 and 185.199.110.153 and 185.199.111.153; read them in the GoDaddy panel first and keep a copy for rollback) with this one record.

value: delete the GitHub Pages AAAA records (expected 2606:50c0:8000::153 and 2606:50c0:8001::153 and 2606:50c0:8002::153 and 2606:50c0:8003::153)
purpose: No AAAA until the edge serves IPv6; a stale GitHub Pages AAAA would send IPv6 visitors to the old site.

name: www
purpose: www redirects to the apex: the edge answers www with a permanent redirect to https://dungeonfluxdnd.com. Replace the existing www CNAME (expected to point at a github.io name; keep a copy for rollback). If the registrar refuses CNAME to @ use dungeonfluxdnd.com. as the value.

name: @ and www and staging
purpose: After a clean day raise the TTLs again.

name: _dmarc.mail
purpose: After two to four weeks of clean aggregate reports tighten the policy to quarantine and later reject.

Optional. The edge obtains certificates automatically (Lets Encrypt with ZeroSSL as the fallback). If a CAA record is added it must list EVERY issuer Caddy may use (also 0 issue "sectigo.com" for ZeroSSL) or issuance fails.
Owner decision. Only if nothing sends or receives mail as dungeonfluxdnd.com itself. Do NOT add it if the apex has any existing mail (check MX first).

type: MX and NS and every other existing TXT
purpose: Mail routing and verification records of the apex are not part of this plan. Never delete an existing MX or NS or verification TXT.

name: staging
value: delete the staging A record BEFORE destroying the staging environment or releasing its reserved address
purpose: A DNS record that outlives its address can be taken over: DigitalOcean may hand the released reserved address to another customer and staging.dungeonfluxdnd.com would then point at them. Do this first and wait out the TTL; the same applies to any record that points at an address you are about to release.
